verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a single mention that Babylon.js's scene graph includes "actions", plus a note that scene interaction works through behaviors and mesh picking. That glancingly suggests a built-in event-to-action mechanism, but nothing documents defining trigger rules or how they fire. missing for 10: documentation of event triggers and rule definition, declarative or no-code rule authoring, conditions and chaining, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Provides a complete scene graph with lights, cameras, materials, meshes, sprites, layers, animations, audio clips, GUI elements, and actions
Offers scene interaction through ray casting, behaviors, and mesh picking
